title: Resin member disposed on path of beam emitted from radar device, radome, and radar device
abstract: The resin component is made of a thermoplastic resin composition, has a relative dielectric constant of 2.9 or less, and has a molding shrinkage rate of 1.2% or less as measured according to JIS K7152-4, and the thermoplastic resin composition contains at least one thermoplastic resin selected from the group consisting of a rubber polymer-reinforced vinyl resin in which a polymer portion derived from a rubber polymer is chemically bonded to a vinyl resin portion derived from a vinyl monomer, a polyolefin resin, and a polycarbonate resin. The resin member can be used as a radome, and can constitute a radar device.
